releases.notes:
## 🎉 Enhanced Stockpile Features

### New Features
- **Deposit System**: Right-click items in stockpile to deposit from inventory
- **Deposit All Button**: Quickly store your entire inventory
- **Item Selling**: Press Q (Drop key) on items to sell them for coins
- **Dynamic Pricing**: 15+ resource types with balanced prices
  - Crops: 2 coins each (wheat, carrot, potato)
  - Logs: 3 coins each
  - Ores: 4-50 coins (coal to diamond)
  - Animal products: 4-10 coins (wool, leather, beef)
- **Contract Integration**: View and complete contracts directly from stockpile
- **View Toggle**: Switch between Resources and Contracts views

### Controls
- **Left-click**: Withdraw 1 stack
- **Shift-left-click**: Withdraw all
- **Right-click**: Deposit from inventory
- **Q (Drop)**: Sell all

### Changes
- Removed debug messages for cleaner gameplay
- Fixed Java GUI compatibility (changed from shift-right-click to Drop key)
- Enhanced tooltips with value calculations

### Technical
- Minecraft 1.21.11
- Fabric API 0.141.1+1.21.11
- Fabric Loader 0.18.4
- SGUI 1.12.0+1.21.11

**Installation**: Drop the JAR into your mods folder with Fabric Loader installed.

releases.notes:
# 🏰 Pocket Settlement: The Governor's Desk v1.0.0

A cozy, Vanilla Plus colony simulator for Minecraft 1.21.11 (Fabric)

## Features
- 7x7 Settlement Grid with 11 building types
- Citizen management with 7 unique jobs (Farmer, Miner, Lumberjack, Rancher, Merchant, Scholar, Guard)
- Technology tree with 25+ research nodes across Industry, Civics, and Logistics
- Daily contract system for earning coins
- Virtual stockpile for resource management
- Adjacency bonuses and synergies between buildings
- All gameplay through beautiful GUI - no world blocks needed!

## How to Play
1. Install Fabric Loader and Fabric API for Minecraft 1.21.11
2. Drop the JAR file into your mods folder
3. Press **G** in-game to open the Governor's Desk
4. Build your settlement and watch it grow!

## Requirements
- Minecraft 1.21.11
- Fabric Loader 0.18.4+
- Fabric API 0.141.1+1.21.11

## Commands
- \/settlement info\ - View settlement overview
- \/settlement citizens\ - List all citizens
- \/settlement buildings\ - Show building grid
- \/settlement tech\ - Display tech tree progress
- \/settlement stockpile\ - View stored resources
